text:
emily: quick pass on a responsive compact latency card. idea: single-row card that shows P95, a micro heatmap, and a tiny sampling chip. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz9999/compact-latency-v3
kevin: looked — love the density. two immediate things: P95 weight drops too much at <320px and heatmap chevrons overlap on Safari.
sara: visual nit: the sampling chip bg is using a pastel green that reads gray on some HDR monitors. consider outline + solid dot instead of filled chip.
anya: accessibility: tab order skips the sampling control in my test. also the chip isn't announced with rate info. we should do role="switch" and aria-label that includes rate (eg "Sampling: on, 5%")
emily: noted — will switch role and aria-label. can we also pick a smaller hit target for the chip (28px) so it fits in one line?
emarcus: caution on hit target — 28px is below recommended 32px. for keyboard users we need >=32px. maybe keep visual smaller but pad the clickable area.
kevin: UX question: for routes with low counts we show a dash now. could we surface an action "Collect more data" that links to sampling controls? avoids confusion.
sara: microcopy suggestion for tooltip: "P95 unavailable — fewer than 100 samples. Enable sampling or widen window." short and actionable.
anya: animation: when collapsing card in list, numbers jump because width animates. prefer crossfade + fixed metric column. this preserves scan patterns for long lists.
emily: will do fixed metric width + crossfade. also I'll mock the focus state (visible 3px ring) and a hover popover that shows full heatmap.
marcus: responsive: on very narrow screens the chip wraps and pushes heatmap down. prefer chip to stay right-aligned and clamp the heatmap to a single condensed sparkline.
kevin: another accessibility thing: announce when sampling changes via aria-live polite so SR users know the rate changed.
a11y-bot: Automated checks: ensure P95 number contrast >= 4.5:1 in compact; sampling control must be reachable via keyboard and announce state; provide aria-live for sampling updates; maintain 32px interactive target (can be visually smaller).
emily: thanks all — I'll update Figma with: fixed-width P95, outline chip + dot, role=switch + aria-label, aria-live message, crossfade heatmap, hover popover, padded hit target. will post screenshots here when done. :raised_hands:
sara: awesome — can we add a tiny "ms" unit under the P95 value on mobile so unit clarity remains?
emarcus: yes, unit helps. good call.
kevin: tiny follow-up: include last-refresh timestamp in the hover popover. people get confused when data is old.
emily: noted. pushing by EOD.
